tie_break: descending score, then lower number; ticket numbers sorted ascending
selection_rule: top six by frozen signal score; no outcome based parameter selection
screening_rule: A signal survives only if all three B similarity thresholds pass; outcome metrics do not enter screening.

signals.name: CROSS_ROUND_MARKOV_v1
signals.formula: mean over m in previous draw of (cooccur[m,n]+20*global_rate[n])/(source_exposure[m]+20)
signals.variables: prior-round source number m; next-round target number n; global_rate from draws 1..t-1

signals.name: CALENDAR_SEASON_CONDITIONAL_v1
signals.variables: fixed four-season bucket of target date; counts of n in prior outcomes from the same season
signals.weight: one season bucket; no learned weight

signals.name: PREVIOUS_SUM_REGIME_CONDITIONAL_v1
signals.variables: sum of draw t-1; fixed bins <120, 120..144, 145..169, >=170; target-number counts in successor draws
